classification_policy: Use deterministic trace fields for objective signals. A1-A5 and A9 are automatic only where structured telemetry supports them. A1 requires explicit provider/API evidence. A6-A8 and A10-A12 require evaluator adjudication or explicit review codes. Never classify from question-specific regexes.

categories.name: provider_api_transient_failure
categories.description: Provider/API transient failure only when explicit provider/API telemetry supports it; generic status=error is not sufficient.

categories.name: deadline_exhaustion
categories.description: Timeout or an emitted deadline-exceeded stage.

categories.name: missing_submit_answer
categories.description: No accepted terminal submission after the bounded continuation allowance.

categories.name: privacy_guard_or_adjudicated_leakage_signal
categories.description: Search-privacy guard violation or separately adjudicated leakage signal; guard violation alone is not proof of leakage.

categories.name: evidence_identity_or_locator_failure
categories.description: Invalid, unregistered, unobserved, ambiguous, guessed, or cross-request evidence identity signal.

categories.name: poor_source_selection
categories.description: The selected source is not fit for the proposition despite a usable authoritative path.

categories.name: source_normalization_or_classification_defect
categories.description: Backend source metadata or authority classification is wrong or incomplete.

categories.name: wrong_claim_to_source_attachment
categories.description: The claim is attached to evidence that does not entail or apply to it.

categories.name: exact_version_applicability_unavailable
categories.description: The postcondition correctly identifies unavailable exact text, document version, or effective interval.

categories.name: postcondition_potentially_too_strict
categories.description: Evaluator/legal adjudication concludes that the evidence postcondition is too strict; the A9 pattern alone is insufficient.

categories.name: luna_reasoning_or_content_error
categories.description: The answer materially misstates, omits, or misapplies the legally relevant issue after evidence review.

categories.name: expected_phase5_capability_limitation
categories.description: Evaluator-assigned expected Phase-5 capability limitation. Bounded-loop violations remain a separate hard-gate metric.
